$comment: Mapping rules from the raw PoB snapshot to the catalog contract (apps/data-pipeline/src/normalize). Astrolabe vocabulary on the right side, PoB field names on the left; no game values.

modTiers.$comment: Tier 1 = highest required level within group + generation type + domains. Only these generation types are tiered.

releaseFacts.$comment: Facts of the release for the guide pipeline. maxLevelTable is a game-data table (config/data-pipeline/game-data.json). mainTree is a rule in PoB's code, not in its data: Build.lua allows 99 points at level 100 (usedMax), i.e. one point per level from level 2 on. Known limit: PoB hard-codes level 100 / 99 points, so a different maxCharacterLevel in the game data would not be reflected by PoB.
